about.bio: I am an experienced Full-Stack Developer and DevOps Engineer with over 17 years of industry experience. I specialize in building modern web applications with Laravel, Vue.js and React, while also managing cloud infrastructure — Docker, AWS and CI/CD pipelines. Currently working at Kuchnia Vikinga and DMservice.

exp.desc1: Development and maintenance of web applications using Laravel with Vue.js, React, Livewire and Inertia.js. Managing cloud infrastructure on AWS (EC2, ECS, RDS, S3, CloudFront). Building CI/CD pipelines and Docker-based environments.
exp.desc2: Development of a CRM/ERP web application with Laravel + Livewire, Linux server administration, PrestaShop modernization. Docker deployment and AWS infrastructure management.
exp.desc3: Development of web applications using Laravel with Vue.js, React, Livewire and Inertia.js. Built new CRM modules and integrated external APIs.
exp.desc4: Building web applications in the Laravel + Vue.js / React ecosystem using Inertia.js and Bootstrap.
exp.desc5: Development and maintenance of web applications using Laravel with Vue.js, Livewire and Tailwind CSS.
exp.desc6: Creating websites and online stores (PrestaShop, WordPress, Joomla) and web applications (CodeIgniter, Yii, Laravel).
